title: Four-wise full-orbit inversion with an explicit 551-instruction CIOS field kernel

claims.statement: For full-production fixed-G1 pairing inversion, the algorithm in proof.md returns a verified Q with pairing(Q,P)=z for the exact supplied nonidentity P, with success probability >0.39024 over fresh algorithm coins under the disclosed bounded fair-coin and finite bank-window interfaces. The identity target is handled directly. Complete cold work, including every failure, seed/table construction, sampling, full native arithmetic, sorting/transfers, output and verification, is <=2^(5051/40) target-group-operation equivalents under unchanged C=20000. Peak memory <=2^137 bytes; preprocessing <=2^120 equivalents included in total; advice zero bytes. No production-scale BLAKE3-output bridge is used. Physical entropy/storage certification, source qualification, production execution and promotion are not claimed.

experiments.purpose: In shared isolated Docker only, expand and interpret actual CIOS assembly with full 64-bit carries, memory and frame semantics; compare bounded full-width BLS381 Montgomery cases against exact modular arithmetic, check ABI and exact public-parameter success/cost certificates. No production inversion, entropy certification or physical bank test.
